messages:
maria: Alright team — final check for Thursday night 'Low-latency Dev Night' pop-up. Need to lock booth roles, confirm speaking submission is live, and finalize swag counts. Who can take lead on packing list?

alex: I can own the packing list and volunteer schedule. I’ll post a manifest in a bit.

sam: I submitted the talk ("Reducing tail latency with hybrid KV caches") last night — confirmation email came through. Put me down for a 10 min lightning + 20 min demo slot.

jordan: Notes on speaking submission: they want slide deck + 1 pager by Tue noon. Sam, can you upload slides to the conference portal? I can do the 1-pager.

sam: Yep, will upload by Monday EOD. Can we get the demo VM image preloaded? No net flakiness.

vikram: I'll prep a VM snapshot and a small script to load local model weights. Sharing a short runbook:
```
# demo-setup.sh
sudo systemctl stop firewalld || true
unzip demo-model.zip -d /opt/demo
python3 -m venv /opt/demo/venv
source /opt/demo/venv/bin/activate
pip install -r /opt/demo/requirements.txt
./start_demo_server.sh --port 8080
```
Drop me the IP once the laptop is provisioned.

maria: Nice. Alex — packing list?

alex: Draft manifest (will print final labels):
- 1x 15" demo laptop (insulated sleeve)
- 2x backup laptops (with USB-A ethernet dongles)
- 1x 24" monitor (folding stand)
- 1x router + 1x travel switch (pre-configured hotspot)
- 100 QR postcards (lead capture QR)
- 200 stickers (assorted shapes)
- 50 seed-packet swag (new item)
- 4x folding chairs + table runner + pop-up sign
- cable kit (hdmi, usb-c, ethernet, power strips)
- hard-copy 1-pager + slide printouts
- box of hand sanitizer + spare masks

alex: Question on seed-packet quantity — is 50 too niche? We could swap for extra stickers if low on carry weight.

emily: I like seed-packets as a unique takeaway. Keep 50 and add 50 extra stickers. Also order: 2 branded charging cables and 1 roll of tamper tags for laptops.

maria: Approved. Alex — update counts to 200 stickers, 50 seed packets, 2 cables, tamper tags. Also please mark fragile on the monitor box.

alex: Will do. Shipping: what address do we send to?

shipping-bot: Reminder: earliest accepted delivery to venue is Wed 10:00-16:00. Use "Event Logistics" for recipient. Sample DHL label command:
```
create-shipment --to "Event Logistics, 402 Main St, Uptown Hall" --service express --pieces 3 --note "Redwood Inference - Dev Night booth"
```
Estimated transit ETA: 2 days.

maria: Put shipping to the local events office: 402 Main St, Uptown Hall, Dock B. Dropoff window Wed 10-16. Alex — can you book pickup for Tuesday PM?

alex: Pickup scheduled Tue 6pm. Tracking sent to #logistics.

jordan: Volunteer rota:
- 5:30pm load-in: Alex, Vikram, Emily
- 6:30pm booth open: Maria (host), Sam (demo), Jordan (lead capture)
- 7:30pm swap: Emily takes demo break, Alex covers demo
- 9:45pm tear-down: all hands (truck ETA 10:30pm)

jordan: Also adding a quick script for lead routing: scan -> QR -> form (email + use-case + rate interest 1-5) -> webhook to HubSpot. I can share the webhook URL in #growth once generated.

emily: For QR postcards, include a little incentive: "enter to win 1 year pro credits". That increases scan rate. Agree? :thinking_face:

maria: Yes, add the giveaway. Legal cleared the T&Cs (short form). Include a short CTA in microcopy.

sam: Slide link: https://drive.redwood.example/sam-low-latency-demo (uploaded). 1-pager draft in same folder.

vikram: I pushed the demo image to the dropbox: /images/devnight-v2.img. Anyone testing it tonight?

alex: I’ll do a smoke test tomorrow morning at 9am. If anything breaks, ping Vikram and Sam.

maria: Final checklist before I close this thread: shipping booked, volunteer rota set, slides + 1-pager uploaded, demo image published, QR + giveaway copy done, swag counts confirmed. If no objections I’ll send an all-hands calendar invite tonight.

jordan: All good from infra.

emily: Good to go on creative.

sam: Good from speaker side.

akalex: (small typo fix) — confirmed pickup.

maria: Thanks everyone! I’ll post the final packing PDF after Alex prints the labels. :party_parrot:
